subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this remain the canonical combined tracker for both embedded-runner import coupling and Discord monitor boundary cleanup, or should maintainers split it between the RuntimePlan RFC and a separate Discord monitor item?
rationale: The remaining work spans two hot ownership boundaries and partially overlaps an open RuntimePlan RFC, so automation should not decide the sequencing or whether to keep the combined tracker.

options.title: Keep Combined Tracker
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical staged refactor covering both embedded-runner and Discord monitor coupling, with maintainers sequencing the actual PRs.

options.title: Split Remaining Scope
options.body: Move embedded-runner cleanup under the RuntimePlan RFC and open or identify a separate Discord monitor boundary issue before closing this combined tracker.

options.title: Defer Until RuntimePlan Lands
options.body: Leave this blocked on the RuntimePlan cleanup direction, then reassess whether the Discord monitor scope still needs a dedicated follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep Combined Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical staged refactor covering both embedded-runner and Discord monitor coupling, with maintainers sequencing the actual PRs.
